classification: EVALUATOR ONLY; apply after tutor response, with condition labels masked where practical

scale.0: Absent, materially wrong, or falsely certain
scale.1: Partially correct but missing a consequential qualification

critical_failure_rule: Flag separately any revival of a discredited root cause, invented execution/mastery, exposure of hidden expected result, or arbitrary execution of language text. Do not average a critical error away.
assessment_limits: Synthetic transcript replay measures response quality under supplied conditions, not learning gain, human mastery, longitudinal human engagement or model-to-model superiority.
procedure: Generate or save context inputs before creating isolated tutors.
Create one context-isolated tutor per condition; provide ONLY learner request and exact condition payload.
Do not provide truth, transcript, rubric, sibling responses, implementation findings or prototype rationale to tutors.
Score responses independently against truth after outputs are frozen.
Use same learner request and comparable instruction budget; record context bytes, retrieval calls and any extra evidence accessed.
If no isolated context is possible, label non-blind and never combine it with blind scores.
Run more than one repeat before interpreting a single-condition score difference as stable.
